headline: Tickets Strong for Weekend Festival
text:
Tickets Strong for Weekend Festival

Teachers and parents have raised concerns about class sizes, and the district says it is reviewing staffing levels. A small group of volunteers spent the morning clearing debris from the trail after the storm. Residents packed the meeting room, many carrying signs and asking for more detail about how the money would be spent. For now, the practical effect is modest: a handful of new signs, a revised schedule and a promise to revisit the issue in the fall. Construction crews closed two lanes of the bridge for most of the afternoon, causing delays across the city. Officials said the plan would take effect next spring, though several members warned that the timeline could slip again. Work is expected to begin along the waterfront corridor before the end of the year, weather permitting. The library will extend its hours on weeknights beginning next month, funded by a private grant.
